component.name: Twinly
component.summary: Write and connect local HTML documents

description.p: Twinly is a native GTK4 and libadwaita writing application with a calm workspace and portable HTML documents.

ul.li: Format text, highlight passages, add lists and embed photos
Organise real folders and connect documents with internal links
Work with two documents and pin a reference alongside your writing
Import ODT, Word and PDF text, preview printing and export PDF, ODT and Word files
Start with an editable English guide and an embedded sample photo

description.p: The interface and Getting Started document are in English. Blur depends on the runtime and compositor.
Public preview preparation with an offline introduction, writable user storage and Flatpak build configuration.
